tbmtools

tbmtools.data_package

Package model output data products for distribution.

This module exports model data from Emme projects, assembles package directories, and renders documentation for the packaged results.

tbmtools.data_package.compress_data(data_dirs, out_dir, config, tag)

Compress exported data directories into ZIP archives.

Parameters:

  • data_dirs (dict) – Mapping of data product names to directories that should be compressed.

  • out_dir (pathlib.Path) – Directory where the ZIP archives will be written.

  • config (dict) – Configuration mapping containing the compressed section that defines the output archive names.

  • tag (str) – Tag appended to each archive filename.

Return type:

None

tbmtools.data_package.copy_data(src_dir, target_dir, config, tag, data_paths)

Copy packaged data files into the output directory.

Parameters:

  • src_dir (pathlib.Path) – Source project directory containing the TG results data.

  • target_dir (pathlib.Path) – Destination directory for the packaged data files.

  • config (dict) – Configuration mapping used to name the copied TG results file.

  • tag (str) – Tag appended to the copied TG results filename.

  • data_paths (dict) – Mapping of exported artifact names to their paths, including the trip roster.

Return type:

None

Raises:

FileNotFoundError – If more than one TG results file is found in the source directory.

tbmtools.data_package.export_data(proj_dir, out_dir, tag, config, modeller)

Export model data products into a staging directory.

Parameters:

  • proj_dir (pathlib.Path) – Project directory containing the Emme model files and supporting data.

  • out_dir (pathlib.Path) – Directory where exported data products will be written.

  • tag (str) – Tag used to distinguish packaged output files.

  • config (dict) – Configuration mapping with scenario and output naming settings.

  • modeller (inro.modeller.Modeller) – Modeller instance used to access Emme tools for exporting data.

Returns:

Mapping of exported data product names to their output paths.

Return type:

dict

tbmtools.transit

The transit subpackage updates the model’s transit network from agency GTFS feeds. Its workflow builds an Emme scenario, loads and transforms the feeds, checks the imported lines against the feed geometry, and exports transit itineraries and data tables.

        flowchart TD
    cli["tbmtools update"] --> update["update.py<br/>run"]
    update --> config["config.py<br/>project settings and Emme"]
    update --> rail["extract_rail_network.py<br/>filter MRN and write base-network file"]
    rail --> basefile["Rail base-network transaction file"]
    update --> clean["transit_feed.py<br/>clean agency GTFS feeds"]
    clean --> feeds["Cleaned GTFS feeds"]

    update --> setup["gtfs_scenario.py<br/>build scenario 900, configure schema,<br/>resize Emme database"]
    basefile --> setup
    setup --> load["transit_feed.py<br/>load feeds into scenario"]
    feeds --> load
    load --> scenario["GTFS transit network<br/>scenario 900"]

    scenario --> verify["update.py<br/>export network and launch verifier"]
    feeds --> verify
    verify --> verifier["verify_transit_network.py<br/>prepare ArcGIS project and jobs"]
    verifier --> analysis["verification.py<br/>compare network lines to feed routes"]
    analysis --> report["Transit line verification CSV"]

    scenario --> tables["transit_tables.py<br/>transform network and export outputs"]
    tables --> outputs["Transit itineraries and data tables"]
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> update
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> rail
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> clean
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> setup
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> load
    config -. settings and Modeller access .-> tables

Module responsibilities

Module

Responsibility

update

Orchestrates the transit update command and its subprocesses.

config

Reads Scripts/transit_update.toml, resolves project paths, and initializes Emme Modeller.

extract_rail_network

Selects the year-specific rail network from the MRN geodatabase and writes an Emme transaction file.

gtfs_scenario

Builds the base network and prepares scenario schema and database capacity for GTFS imports.

transit_feed

Cleans agency feed files, classifies routes, and imports feeds into the scenario.

verify_transit_network

Prepares the ArcGIS verification project, runs route checks, and writes the report.

verification

Performs per-route network/feed geometry comparisons in worker processes.

transit_tables

Transforms the imported network and exports itineraries and model data tables.
